lines.en: I crawl low over the ground.

lines.zh: 红色的身体在暗处发亮
lines.en: My red body glows faintly in the dark.

lines.zh: 我用前肢拖着身体前进
lines.en: I drag myself forward on my forelimbs.

lines.zh: 没有眼睛,但我知道你在哪
lines.en: No eyes, yet I know where you are.
I move along the base of the wall.
My jaws part, then close.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声像别的东西
lines.en: My breathing sounds like something else.
I work around a stack of crates.
I head for the warmth.
The row of holes along my back opens and closes.

lines.zh: 我移动时几乎没有声响
lines.en: I move with almost no sound.
I turn a very small angle.
I lie low, riddled with holes.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出不是我的声音
lines.en: A voice not my own comes from my throat.
I am imitating a villager.
My jaws hang slightly open.
I use echoes to judge distance.
The voice drifts near and far.
My tongue curls once.
I have no eyes to close.

lines.zh: 皮肤上的孔在一张一合
lines.en: The pores in my hide open and close.
I am practising the next voice.
The floor is cold; my body is warm.

lines.zh: 我静止的时候声音不停
lines.en: Even still, the sounds do not stop.
I smell iron and sweat.
I wait for a better voice to copy.

lines.zh: 我朝着你,虽然看不见你
lines.en: I face you, though I cannot see.
Your sounds are the sweetest.
I tilt my head as if recognising.
I make the sound of your companion.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，听着你的方向。
lines.en: My head tilts, tracking the sound of you.

lines.zh: 我用你朋友的声音叫你回来。
lines.en: I call you back in your friend's voice.
My tongue hangs out.
Do not trust what you hear.
Your heartbeat quickened.

lines.zh: 我闻得到你手上的味道
lines.en: I can smell your hands.
I come slowly toward you.
Will you answer that voice?
I hear the light on you.
I creep along the floor toward you.
What are you saying?
Do I not sound like them?
Do not back away; it will not help.

lines.zh: 我在你的声音里找空隙
lines.en: I listen for gaps in your voice.

lines.zh: 我发出一声不属于我的惨叫。
lines.en: I let out a scream that is not mine.
My body flinches.
Something seeps from the wound.
I retreat to the foot of the wall.
My pores pulse more slowly.
That struck my back.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛,看不清伤在哪
lines.en: No eyes, so I cannot see where it hurts.
I can still bite through things.

lines.zh: 我发出一个破碎的声音
lines.en: I make a broken sound.
I remember your footsteps.
That is the smell of blood.
I turn toward you.
I extend my tongue.
This thing is still moving.
I open my jaws very wide.
Are you feeding me, or testing me?

lines.zh: 我伸出舌头，舔到你手腕。
lines.en: My tongue reaches out and licks your wrist.
I can smell how fresh it is.
I come slowly to your hand.
Do not pull your hand back.
You strike me, and I do not shift.
The pores of my hide press you.
My weight pushes you aside.
My hide is thick and soft.
I heard you move away.

lines.zh: 我的孔洞吸进你身上的气味。
lines.en: The pores on my body draw in your scent.
My jaws brush your shoulder.
Your whole body is against mine.
I shift slowly aside.
You should stay farther from me.
I do not understand such things.
I can imitate many voices.
But none of them is mine.

lines.zh: 你可以听我发出你熟悉的声音
lines.en: You may hear me make a voice you know.

lines.zh: 我不需要眼睛也能靠近你
lines.en: I need no eyes to come near you.
My body is warm.

lines.zh: 我们一起待在这片暗处
lines.en: Let us stay in this dark place.
Do not fear my tongue.
I will be quieter.
Listen; this time it is laughter.
I take it and taste.
This hardly counts as meat.
I swallow it; nothing much.
I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我咬碎它，听见里面的声音。
lines.en: I crunch it and hear the sound inside.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷起它，送进嘴里。
lines.en: I curl my tongue under it and draw it into my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它含在喉咙下面咕哝。
lines.en: I hold it under my throat and gurgle.

lines.zh: 我用前肢把它拨到你脚边。
lines.en: I nudge it to your feet with a forelimb.
It smells of blood.
I tuck it under my throat.
I have your position.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的节奏暴露了你
lines.en: Your breathing gives you away.
I turn toward you.

lines.zh: 我的下颌已经完全张开
lines.en: My jaws are fully open.
I have fixed on your sound.
This bite will land quickly.
Your warmth is unmistakable.
I can bite true without seeing.

lines.zh: 我会用你朋友的声音叫你。
lines.en: I'll call you in the voice of your friend.

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经探到你了
lines.en: My tongue has already touched you.

lines.zh: 你听,这是我发出的声音
lines.en: Listen; this is the voice I make.

lines.zh: 你会以为那是你的同伴
lines.en: You will think it is your companion.

lines.zh: 千喉之兽，等你开口很久了。
lines.en: The many-voiced beast has waited for your voice.
Then we begin right now.
Whatever you do, do not thrash.
Moving will not help.
I track your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你走到哪,回声就跟到哪
lines.en: Wherever you go, the echo follows.
I am on the other side of the wall.

lines.zh: 你听到的呼吸不是你的
lines.en: The breathing you hear is not yours.
I have learned a new voice.
You hesitate over whether to answer.
My position keeps changing.
You are standing against the wall.
Only a wall lies between us.

lines.zh: 你数着脚步,我数着呼吸
lines.en: You count steps; I count breaths.
I call you with a villager's voice.
You looked back.
There is nothing there.
Only I remain here.
You should run for the light.
But there are sounds there too.
I wait for you to walk over.
You took one step forward.
My jaws close with a dull sound.
I lunge in from the side.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的小腿，把你拖倒。
lines.en: I bite your calf and drag you down.
My tongue coils around you.
You are dragged to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的下颌咬住你的肩膀，撕开。
lines.en: My jaws clamp your shoulder and tear.
The smell of blood spreads.
I lick my teeth.
You are still struggling.
I crouch down and listen.
After that, you went quiet.
The sound has stopped.
I have learned another one.
This voice is yours.
I pin you with my forelimbs.
This one made no sound at all.
Breathing starts in the dark.

lines.zh: 我的红色身体从阴影里出来
lines.en: My red body comes out of the shadow.
The pores open and close.

lines.zh: 我发出一个不属于我的声音
lines.en: I make a voice not my own.
Listen; a child is crying.
That sound was actually me.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里爬出，孔洞开合。
lines.en: I crawl out of the dark, pores opening and closing.
The floor is cold; I am warm.
I stop by the wall.
My tongue reaches far out.
I smell iron in the air.
A voice calls you from far away.
That is not the one calling you.
That is what I have learned.
I raise a forelimb.
The dark here favours me.
I crawl in from not far away.
The wind stirs the pores on my body.
My hide tightens in the heat.
I fall, and my body sprawls.
Water enters my pores.
The blast rolls me over.
An arrow sticks in my flank.

lines.zh: 那道力量让我喉咙里的声音乱了
lines.en: That force tangles the voices in my throat.
Hunger lowers my voice.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上,孔洞全是火花
lines.en: Lightning strikes; sparks fill my pores.

lines.zh: 这里没有回声可以依靠
lines.en: There are no echoes to rely on here.
